narrative.intro: Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture has $251M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture received 15 awards so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $16.7M. Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture obligations are down 33.8% year over year. Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture recorded annual obligations of $277M in FY21, $228M in FY22, $249M in FY23, $478M in FY24, and $379M in FY25, showing how FY2026 to date fits into recent history. Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture is concentrated in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) with $251M in obligations. Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture figures reported here are contract obligations except where tables list award-value totals, and current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date. This summary highlights the size, award profile, trend, and market concentration of Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture in the current fiscal year.
